dish: Hiyake Shīsā no Taco Rice (日焼けシーサーのタコライス) — Okinawa-only taco rice with a toasted-tortilla 'sunburnt shīsā' and chopped takuan (¥1,870)
n: Chiikawa Restaurant Okinawa, PARCO CITY Urasoe (ちいかわレストラン 沖縄店)
address: San-A Urasoe Nishi-Kaigan PARCO CITY, 3-1-1 Irijima, Urasoe, Okinawa, Japan
w: The second permanent Chiikawa Restaurant in Japan after Ikebukuro PARCO, a family-restaurant-style character café that opened on 13 February 2026 inside San-A Urasoe Nishi-Kaigan PARCO CITY. Alongside the shared grand menu it serves Okinawa-only dishes: the 'sunburnt shīsā' taco rice, a 'mensōre' banana split and a shīsā sanpin-tea tropical drink.
anime: Chiikawa (ちいかわ, Nagano's manga/anime) — only the 2nd permanent Chiikawa Restaurant nationwide, with Okinawa-exclusive menu
